title: Hajmiy og'irlik — yengil posilka nega qimmat
caption: 📦 Kurtka 1 kg chiqdi, kuryer 10 kg uchun pul so'radi. Nega? Bu — hajmiy og'irlik. Katta, lekin yengil qutida kuryer haqiqiy og'irlik emas, quti hajmi bo'yicha hisoblaydi. 🧮 Formula (ko'p xizmatlarda): uzunlik × kenglik × balandlik (sm) ÷ 5 000 Misol: puxovik 50×40×25 sm qutida • Haqiqiy og'irlik — 1,2 kg • Hajmiy — 50×40×25 ÷ 5 000 = 10 kg • Kuryer kattasini oladi → 10 kg uchun to'laysiz ✅ Qanday tejash mumkin 1. Kuryerdan qayta qadoqlashni so'rang — 40×30×12 sm paketda hajmiy og'irlik 2,9 kg 2. Bir nechta buyurtmani bitta qutiga birlashtiring (konsolidatsiya) 3. Hajmiy og'irlik qoidasini va bo'luvchini (5000 yoki 6000) xizmatning o'zidan so'rang 📲 Yetkazishni ilovada hisoblang ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #kuryer
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#kuryer".
2) Center: a large mostly empty cardboard box with a small folded puffer jacket inside, a tape measure stretched along its edges, and next to it the same jacket packed tightly in a small flat poly mailer. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of amber (#F59E0B); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Hajmiy og'irlik nima?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Katta quti — katta to'lov"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Hajmiy og'irlik — xalqaro kuryer xizmatlarida keng qo'llanadigan amaliyot; bo'luvchi (5000/6000) va qoidani har bir kuryer xizmati o'zi belgilaydi. Raqamlar misol uchun.
